Apple-centric optimization is preferred where materially useful without
locking shared cores. WebApp/PWA progression: LINK → TAB/WEBAPP → EMBED
→ NATIVE, choosing smallest adequate form. External mature capability is
reused: native OS/app, provider, redirect/handoff, standard/protocol,
library/CLI/API. BIFROST connects/keeps but is not mandatory gateway.
HEIMDALL composes but does not own specialist logic. Authentication may
use mature providers; EDEN identity/authorization remains stable and
provider-independent. Google/Apple productivity services may be
linked/redirected/integrated rather than recreated.
